items.title: Pay veterinary invoice
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 17.04.2026; this is the start of the period. Per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event is not counted, so counting starts 18.04.2026 as day 1. Day 14 of the period falls on 01.05.2026 (Friday). 1 May is 'Tag der Arbeit', a nationwide public holiday. Since this is a payment owed to a company, the payer's own Land (NW) applies, but 1 May is a national holiday so it counts everywhere. Under § 193 BGB, if the due date falls on a Sunday, a recognised public holiday, or a Saturday, the next Werktag applies instead. The day immediately following (02.05.2026) is a Saturday, which is itself excluded by § 193 BGB, so the deadline moves to the next actual working day, Monday 04.05.2026.
